prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE independent transparent RGBA game HUD objective/status icon designed to remain legible at native 32x32 pixels.
Primary request: redraw the exact original Empire C02 sci-fi icon motif in the approved chunky matte system. Image 1 is the subject/identity/composition reference ONLY; remove its magenta backdrop entirely by creating a new transparent image, never reproduce magenta in the output. Image 2 is the approved style/material reference ONLY; do not copy its tool subject.
Subject and invariant functional marks/counts: Preserve the verified rescue status motif: ONE thick life buoy above ONE open upturned armored robotic hand. The buoy has exactly EIGHT broad alternating segments: FOUR muted orange and FOUR warm ivory, a large empty center hole, and one simple tan rope running around its outer rim with only a few broad attachments. Below/right, one gray segmented glove opens upward to help, with one thumb and four fingers grouped into readable broad plates, connected to one short dark wrist cuff at lower-left. Preserve the cuff's cyan rectangular display and small amber trim. Keep the buoy larger than the glove, with the glove just overlapping the lower-right ring edge as in the reference. Use broad solid shapes, no tiny rope braid, surface scratches or excessive finger joints. No second hand, extra ring, person, water, medical cross, text or background.
Style: broad sculpted polygonal planes, warm matte highlights, strong clean nearly-black contour, thick simplified internal separations, weighty toy-like construction and very restrained surface detail matching Image 2. Polished hand-painted game art, not photography, vector signage, pixel art, or a detailed tiny scene. Downsampled 32px readability is the priority.
Composition: one centered complete isolated icon in a SQUARE canvas, around 84-88% of the full canvas extent, with genuine transparent safety margin on every side. Preserve main reference orientation. No part may touch or clip against the outer canvas.
Transparency: actual transparent RGBA, every non-subject pixel fully transparent. Near-opaque material planes, crisp antialiasing only on subject edges. No colored background, magenta spill, gradient, checkerboard, ground, floor, cast/drop shadow, external glow, bloom, haze, vignette, panel border, text, numbers, watermark or signature. All accents remain on bounded subject shapes. Outermost canvas perimeter fully transparent. One icon only, no board or variants.
